headword: {上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}
reading: じょうわんにとうきん

definitions.explanation: The large muscle on the front of the upper arm that flexes the elbow; the biceps. An anatomical term that is also common in fitness contexts.

examples.japanese: {上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}を{鍛|きた}える。
{腕|うで}を{曲|ま}げると{上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}が{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: When you bend your arm, the biceps bulges.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}いものを{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる{動作|どうさ}では、{上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}が{大|おお}きく{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: In the motion of lifting heavy objects, the biceps works hard.

notes:
{上腕|じょうわん} (upper arm) + {二頭|にとう} (two-headed) + {筋|きん} (muscle). The muscle you flex to make a "muscle bump."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}を{鍛|きた}える: to train the biceps
- {力|ちから}こぶ: the bulge of a flexed biceps (colloquial)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上腕三頭筋|じょうわんさんとうきん}: triceps — the muscle on the back of the upper arm
